description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Mystic Retrieval by paying {3}{U}, returning Runic Repetition to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Mystic Retrieval from your graveyard for its flashback cost by paying {2}{R}, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand and exiling Mystic Retrieval.
Cast Runic Repetition by paying {2}{U}, returning Mystic Retrieval from exile to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
